what: Of the explainer cards stacked in one spot, only one stands — on change the old card rotates 16° around its bottom-right corner, flies off to the upper right (45%·−35%) and vanishes, while the new card rises from 110% below and stands (both .45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)). For swapping the bottom-right explainer card per scene in a scroll story.

options.start: Number of the card to raise first, default 0 (if data-active exists, that is used)
options.fx:show: Sent to the element, it raises the card with the detail number (−1 lowers all). Changing data-active does the same
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Cards to swap in — stacked in the same spot

note: Card heights vary, so the slot (element) height is set by the user — cards stick to the bottom and right and grow upward

from.where: shared.js BS.setCard · .bs-cards — swaps the bottom-right story card (white plate · black plate) at set points of scene progress (original Vue swap hero-card .45s)
